_README: Optional. Map faculty initials -> full names. connect.json only carries initials, so the app shows e.g. 'SWK' everywhere; if you add a mapping here it renders as 'SWK · Saharia Islam' in class blocks, chips and the faculty picker. Keys must match the initials exactly as they appear in the data (uppercase).
_how_to_get_names: Ask your department for the initials list, or fill in what you know — unknown initials just keep showing as-is.
